Title: Intrro: The fastest way to get employee referrals | Product Hunt
Intrro is productizing the ability to learn who are the top performers in your company’s network—so you can hire more from recommendations. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Intrro. Intrro sounds like it would save employees and employers alike a lot of time chasing cold leads. Is there going to be a mobile application in the future? Would be much more accessible for users like me. @guptaakshitaa thanks your feedback Akshita - we're going to be building for mobile responsive first so that should help! It’s no secret that your network is one of the best assets in business. 🚀 We built Intrro because there’s a palpable tension between the pain caused by the talent shortage and the expense of interviewing the wrong people. By using data science to surface the relevant talent to open positions, hiring teams get warm intro’s into great talent. In a world where mission, values and culture are becoming more important, your co-workers are the perfect vehicle to identify, verify and attract top talent at scale. Intrro also enables recruiters to browse their employee's contacts against open positions, and proactively ask for an intro, allowing them to spend more time speaking to receptive candidates and less time chasing leads, whilst giving hiring managers access to a broader, verified and more diverse pool of talent. We focus on referrals on collaborative hiring today, but soon we’ll go into intrro’s for the purposes of building a company networking system, and beyond! We offer a free trial to get going! I think this is the future of recruitment; at least for those who want to build a sustainable team. @razvan\_statescu It seems to me that it is helpful even now :) Many companies will succeed in hiring employees with similar values and vision. Thanks for sharing, I am very impressed with your post. @robertsmetcalf Thanks a lot for your support, Robert. There are so many challenges in choosing individuals that fit all the set criteria but I think with Intrro, this will make our job easier. Thanks a lot for your support! Intrro is doing an amazing job in helping to hire more from recommendations.

results.content: # ReferLink. ## Calendly for job referrals. ## Calendly for job referrals. Securing referrals is the worst part of a job hunt. ReferLink automates the referral process so you can focus on landing your dream job. Simply create a ReferLink, share it with your extended network, and let the referrals pile up. ### Productivity. ### Trending categories. ### Trending products. * POLL: Domain or product first? * YC deadline in <2 weeks; Who's applying? ### Have a question about ReferLink? AppSignal — Built for dev teams, not Fortune 500s. Built for dev teams, not Fortune 500s. ### Do you use ReferLink? If you’ve applied for a job recently, you probably had to send a message that went something like this: “So sorry to bother you, I’m just following up to see if you’ve gotten the chance to refer me to that role at your company as we discussed last week..?” 🫣 This is one of the most painfully awkward things I’ve ever had to do. We all know that referrals are an invaluable tool when job-hunting, but securing and managing them is incredibly uncomfortable and overwhelming. I’m excited to announce the launch of ReferLink, an app that automates the job referral process so you can focus on landing your dream job. No more cluttered excel spreadsheets and last minute LinkedIn outreach to try to secure referrals — ReferLink streamlines the whole process into three easy steps: 1. This is a page that displays your referral requests ✅ 2. Send it to your network (or post it on LinkedIn) 💌 3. We do the rest (including handling that horrible follow-up!), and you get referred 💪 I built this tool to make my own job hunt easier, and now I’m looking for feedback from YOU! There’s nobody I trust more than the PH community to help me in my pursuit of simplified job referrals. A few questions to ponder as you start to use — How did you previously find and keep track of job referrals? What was the most awkward part of the process for you? How can you leverage your \*extended\* network to get referred? No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for ReferLink.

results.content:
Title: Firstbase Agent Intro: The #1 Business Compliance Solution — Now Free of Charge | Product Hunt
# Firstbase Agent Intro. ## The #1 Business Compliance Solution — Now Free of Charge. The simplest way to manage business compliance! Forget scrolling through state websites— we file your beneficial ownership report, provide an overview of your compliance, track your deadlines, and list your required actions so you can focus on your business. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Firstbase Agent Intro. Our mission at Firstbase is to be your simple all-in-one company management platform, so you can focus on building your business. To further that mission, today we’re excited to announce Agent Intro — the simplest way to manage business compliance free of charge! Agent Intro is designed for founders who currently manage their business compliance outside of the Firstbase platform. 📁 Initial beneficial ownership information (BOI) filing: The U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network requires all companies to file this, and we’ll take care of it for you! 2. 🚥 Firstbase command center: Get an instant overview of your compliance status in every state where your business operates. 3. ✅ State compliance reminders: We’ll track your deadlines and let you know about any required actions. What distinguishes Agent Intro from our other Agent products? Our other plans: Agent Light, Autopilot, and Payroll, each include registered agent services. US businesses must have a registered agent in each state where they operate. This is why all Firstbase businesses are required to select Light, Autopilot, or Payroll for each state they operate in. With that in mind, Agent Intro is the no-brainer pick for companies that already have registered agents, but still want access to the other features of Firstbase Agent. What is the beneficial ownership information filing? This includes information about your company, the people who set up your company, and your company owners. This information must be filed with the U.S. government shortly after your business is incorporated. @arman\_firstbase Excited about Firstbase's Agent Intro! Can't wait to join the waitlist and see how it streamlines my business operations. Now you can spend more time on what you love – the parts of your business that really spark your passion.
